title: From Reasoning Depth to Reasoning Breadth: Evaluating Multi-Point Associative Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.10444v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress on reasoning tasks that require increasingly long and complex inferential chains. This progress primarily reflects reasoning depth. A complementary and comparatively unexamined capability is reasoning breadth: exploring multiple semantic directions in parallel and integrating the resulting clues into one coherent answer. We introduce MPAR-Bench, a bilingual English-Chinese benchmark that isolates reasoning breadth through multi-point associative reasoning. Inspired by the cooperative game Just One, each item asks a model to recover a hidden target from several independently generated, semantically diverse clues. We construct 1,000 items using a multi-agent clue-generation pipeline, embedding-based diversity filtering, and human verification. Only the answer space is drawn from public word lists, whereas every clue set is generated from scratch. Beyond exact-match accur

translated_title: 从推理深度到推理广度：评估大型语言模型中的多点联想推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.10444v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）在需要越来越长且复杂推理链的任务上取得了显著进展。这一进展主要反映了推理深度。一个互补但相对未被充分研究的能力是推理广度：并行探索多个语义方向，并将所得线索整合成一个连贯的答案。我们引入了MPAR-Bench，一个中英双语基准测试，通过多点联想推理来隔离推理广度。受合作游戏《Just One》启发，每个项目要求模型从多个独立生成、语义多样的线索中恢复一个隐藏目标。我们使用多代理线索生成流程、基于嵌入的多样性过滤以及人工验证构建了1000个项目。只有答案空间来自公开词汇表，而每个线索集都是从零开始生成的。除了精确匹配准确率之外，该基准测试还提供了对模型在广泛关联推理中能力的全面评估。
tldr: 本文提出了MPAR-Bench，一个中英双语基准测试，专门用于评估大型语言模型在多点联想推理中的“推理广度”能力，通过多线索整合来补充传统的“推理深度”评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MPAR-Bench, a bilingual Chinese-English benchmark designed to evaluate "reasoning breadth" in large language models through multi-point associative reasoning, complementing traditional "reasoning depth" assessments by integrating multiple semantic clues.
